subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw core ship `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` now, or should the SQLite artifact contract stay in the Scout/Lobster plugin pilot until the RFC and stress evidence are accepted?
rationale: The PR adds a new sensitive state/restore CLI surface, and its own body says pilot data should decide whether the long-term surface is core, host-owned plugin, or both; automation can fix the diff-local blockers but cannot choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Fix blockers, then defer final approval
options.body: Remove the lockfile and stale startup-policy churn first, then have the assigned maintainer decide after the pilot/RFC evidence is reviewed.

options.title: Accept the core MVP after repairs
options.body: Maintainers can decide that the local-only backup command is the right core primitive once the mechanical blockers are gone.

options.title: Keep it host-owned for now
options.body: Maintainers can pause or close the core PR and continue proving the contract through the host/plugin path if the pilot shows core is premature.

recommendation.title: Fix blockers, then defer final approval
recommendation.body: Remove the lockfile and stale startup-policy churn first, then have the assigned maintainer decide after the pilot/RFC evidence is reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assigned reviewer and already reviewed the remaining SQLite snapshot invariants on this PR.
